entities.name: German People's Party (1868)
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The German People's Party was a German liberal party created in 1868 by the former wing of the German National Association which during the conflict about whether the unification of Germany should be led by the Kingdom of Prussia or Austria-Hungary supported Austria. The party was most popular in Southern Germany.
